rules: Use rose gold as the single artifact accent.
Use asymmetry, scale, hairlines, and negative space instead of decorative cards.
Do not use unverified product or collection imagery.
Never set a collection name in .sr-title or .sr-hero-mark; hero titles are collection lockup images, never type-rendered.
Do not use gradient text, generic luxury serif styling, glass blur, fake scarcity, or ornamental motion.
Every sales visual must remain truthful about what is implemented and what is only a blueprint.
